tweaks.name: Apply Recommended Privacy Tweaks
tweaks.description: Applies every Privacy tweak marked Recommended in one batch (never Danger Zone or permanent items). A restore point is offered first.

tweaks.name: Turn Off Windows Widgets
tweaks.description: Removes the Widgets board and its news feed (and the background process that keeps it updated) via policy.

tweaks.name: Disable Activity History Tracking
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from collecting and uploading the history of apps, files and sites you open (Timeline / activity feed).

tweaks.name: Disable Location Tracking
tweaks.description: Denies location access for all apps (system-wide consent switch). Weather and Maps will no longer auto-detect your location.

tweaks.name: Configure Storage Sense / Cleanup Rules
tweaks.description: Turns on Storage Sense weekly: deletes temporary app files and Recycle Bin items older than 30 days; never touches Downloads.

tweaks.name: Block Apps Running in Background
tweaks.description: Prevents Store/UWP apps from running in the background. Desktop (Win32) apps are unaffected.
tweaks.warning: Store apps such as Phone Link or Xbox may stop delivering background notifications.

tweaks.name: Remove Microsoft Store from Search Results
tweaks.description: Stops Windows offering "Look for an app in the Microsoft Store" for unknown file types and Store results.

tweaks.name: Block Microsoft Telemetry Data Collection
tweaks.description: Sets diagnostic data to the lowest level Windows 11 Pro honours (Required/Security) via both policy locations.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
tweaks.description: Stops crash reports being collected and sent to Microsoft.

tweaks.name: Turn Off Microsoft Copilot AI
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Copilot integration for this user and machine-wide.

tweaks.name: Disable Xbox Background Services
tweaks.description: Disables the Xbox authentication, cloud save, networking and accessory services (XblAuthManager, XblGameSave, XboxNetApiSvc, XboxGipSvc).
tweaks.targetSummary: Service XblAuthManager → Disabled; Service XblGameSave → Disabled; Service XboxNetApiSvc → Disabled; Service XboxGipSvc → Disabled
tweaks.warning: Breaks Xbox app / Game Pass sign-in, cloud saves and Xbox controller accessory updates. The Xbox app is installed on this PC.

tweaks.name: Turn Off Game DVR and Xbox Bar
tweaks.description: Disables background game recording (Game DVR) and capture, which can cost frame time while gaming.

tweaks.name: Disable Handwriting & Typing Data Collection
tweaks.description: Stops Windows learning from your inking and typing to build a personal dictionary in the cloud.

tweaks.name: Disable Input Personalization
tweaks.description: Turns off online speech/ink/typing personalization via policy.

tweaks.name: Disable Tailored Experiences
tweaks.description: Stops Microsoft using diagnostic data to personalise tips, ads and recommendations.

tweaks.name: Disable App Launch Tracking
tweaks.description: Stops Windows tracking which apps you launch to personalise Start and search.

tweaks.name: Stop Windows Feedback Prompts
tweaks.description: Never ask for feedback (SIUF) and hide feedback notifications.

tweaks.name: Block Delivery Optimization Peer Sharing (Policy)
tweaks.description: Updates download only from Microsoft (HTTP), never uploading to or from other PCs.

tweaks.name: Disable Advertising ID
tweaks.description: Turns off the per-user advertising identifier apps use for targeted ads.

tweaks.name: Block Suggested Content in Settings
tweaks.description: Hides suggested content and promotions inside the Settings app.

tweaks.name: Disable Lock Screen Spotlight
tweaks.description: Stops rotating Spotlight images, fun facts and tips on the lock screen.

tweaks.name: Block Silently Installed Apps
tweaks.description: Prevents Windows from silently installing suggested Store apps.

tweaks.name: Disable Pre-installed App Suggestions
tweaks.description: Stops OEM and Microsoft pre-installed app suggestions and Start suggestions.

tweaks.name: Disable Bing Web Results in Search
tweaks.description: Start/taskbar search shows only local results — no Bing web suggestions.

tweaks.name: Disable Cortana
tweaks.description: Disables Cortana via policy.

tweaks.name: Disable Search Highlights
tweaks.description: Removes trending/"today in history" highlights from the search box and search home.

tweaks.name: Disable Microsoft Store Search Suggestions
tweaks.description: Stops search from querying online/cloud sources (Store and Microsoft account content) as you type.

tweaks.name: Disable Clipboard Cloud Sync
tweaks.description: Prevents clipboard content being synced to your other devices through the cloud.

tweaks.name: Disable Clipboard History
tweaks.description: Turns off Win+V clipboard history (items are no longer stored).

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Settings Sync
tweaks.description: Stops syncing themes, passwords and preferences across devices with your Microsoft account.

tweaks.name: Disable Find My Device
tweaks.description: Turns off device location reporting for Find My Device (not useful on a desktop).

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Recall
tweaks.description: Disables Recall snapshots and blocks Recall from being enabled.

tweaks.name: Disable Click To Do
tweaks.description: Disables Click to Do screen analysis.

tweaks.name: Disable Edge Compose AI
tweaks.description: Disables Compose (AI writing) in Microsoft Edge.

tweaks.name: Disable Paint AI Features (Cocreator)
tweaks.description: Disables Cocreator, Generative Fill and Image Creator in Paint.

tweaks.name: Disable Notepad AI Features
tweaks.description: Disables Rewrite/Summarize AI features in Notepad.

tweaks.name: Disable AI Service Auto-Start (AiHost)
tweaks.description: Sets the Windows AI host service to manual start so it only runs when an AI feature asks for it. Skipped if the service is not present.

tweaks.name: Disable Edge Usage Data Reporting
tweaks.description: Stops Edge sending usage and crash data. (Edge policy)

tweaks.name: Disable Edge Site Info Collection
tweaks.description: Stops Edge sending info about the sites you visit. (Edge policy)

tweaks.name: Disable Edge Personalization Reporting
tweaks.description: Stops browsing activity being used to personalise ads and news. (Edge policy)

tweaks.name: Block Copilot Page Access in Edge
tweaks.description: Prevents Copilot reading the page you are on. (Edge policy)

tweaks.name: Block Copilot Page Context in Edge
tweaks.description: Prevents Edge passing page context to Copilot. (Edge policy)

tweaks.name: Disable Edge Discover Page Scanning
tweaks.description: Stops the Discover pane scanning page content. (Edge policy)

tweaks.name: Hide the Edge Sidebar
tweaks.description: Removes the Edge sidebar. (Edge policy)

tweaks.name: Disable Edge Shopping Assistant
tweaks.description: Disables price comparison and coupon pop-ups. (Edge policy)

tweaks.name: Disable Chrome Usage Statistics
tweaks.description: Stops Chrome sending usage statistics and crash reports.

tweaks.name: Disable Chrome Feedback Reports
tweaks.description: Disables the Chrome feedback reporter.

tweaks.name: Disable Chrome Extended Safe Browsing Reporting
tweaks.description: Stops sending extra page data to Google for Safe Browsing. Standard Safe Browsing protection stays ON.

tweaks.name: Disable Firefox Telemetry
tweaks.description: Disables Firefox telemetry via enterprise policy.

tweaks.name: Disable Firefox Default Browser Agent
tweaks.description: Stops the scheduled agent that reports your default-browser choice to Mozilla.

tweaks.name: Refresh Optional Features Status
tweaks.description: Re-reads the live install state of every Optional Windows Feature (read-only).

tweaks.name: Toggle Microsoft Print to PDF
tweaks.description: Removes the Microsoft Print to PDF virtual printer. Revert re-enables it.

tweaks.name: Toggle Legacy Windows Media Player
tweaks.description: Removes legacy Windows Media Player (the modern Media Player app is unaffected). Revert re-enables it.

tweaks.name: Toggle Work Folders Sync Client
tweaks.description: Removes the Work Folders corporate sync client. Revert re-enables it.

tweaks.name: Toggle Internet Explorer 11
tweaks.description: Removes the Internet Explorer 11 engine (also used by Edge IE mode). Revert re-enables it.

tweaks.name: Toggle XPS Document Support
tweaks.description: Removes the XPS document printer and services. Revert re-enables it.

tweaks.name: Toggle Telnet Client
tweaks.description: Ensures the insecure Telnet client is turned off. Revert re-enables it.

tweaks.name: Toggle SMB 1.0 File Sharing
tweaks.description: Keeps the obsolete, wormable SMB 1.0 protocol turned off. Changing SMB1 is Danger Zone because re-enabling it on revert exposes the PC.
tweaks.warning: Old NAS boxes and very old network devices that only speak SMB1 will stop working.

tweaks.name: Remove or Restore Microsoft Store
tweaks.description: Removes the Microsoft Store for all users and de-provisions it. Use "Reinstall Microsoft Store" to get it back.
tweaks.warning: Store-delivered app updates (Xbox app, NVIDIA App components, Windows apps) stop until the Store is reinstalled.

tweaks.name: Uninstall OneDrive
tweaks.description: Runs Microsoft's OneDrive uninstaller. Files already in your OneDrive cloud are kept online; local sync stops.
tweaks.warning: OneDrive is installed and in use on this PC.

tweaks.name: Uninstall Microsoft Edge
tweaks.description: Runs Edge's own system-level uninstaller. WebView2 (used by many apps) is NOT removed.
tweaks.warning: Windows may block or later reinstall Edge outside the EEA. Some Windows links will open nothing until another browser is default.

tweaks.name: Stop Edge from Reinstalling Itself
tweaks.description: Disables the Edge update services (edgeupdate, edgeupdatem) and blocks automatic Chromium Edge redeployment.
tweaks.targetSummary: Service edgeupdate → Disabled; Service edgeupdatem → Disabled; HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate\DoNotUpdateToEdgeWithChromium
tweaks.warning: Edge (and WebView2 delivered by Edge Update) will no longer receive security updates.

tweaks.name: Reinstall Microsoft Store
tweaks.description: Reinstalls / repairs the Microsoft Store (wsreset -i).

tweaks.name: Apply Recommended Services Tweaks
tweaks.description: Applies all Recommended service changes (telemetry & safe-to-disable services only).

tweaks.name: Disable Telemetry Service Group
tweaks.description: Disables Connected User Experiences & Telemetry and the WAP push routing service.
tweaks.targetSummary: Service DiagTrack → Disabled; Service dmwappushservice → Disabled

tweaks.name: Disable Search Indexing Service Group
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Search indexing and SysMain (Superfetch). On fast NVMe SSDs the benefit of both is small.
tweaks.targetSummary: Service WSearch → Disabled; Service SysMain → Disabled
tweaks.warning: Start-menu and File Explorer search become slower (no index).

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Update Service Group
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Update, Update Orchestrator, Update Medic, BITS and Delivery Optimization services.
tweaks.targetSummary: Service wuauserv → Disabled; Service UsoSvc → Disabled; Service WaaSMedicSvc → Disabled; Service bits → Disabled; Service DoSvc → Disabled
tweaks.warning: No security updates, Store updates or Defender platform updates until reverted. This PC runs an Insider build (26300).

tweaks.name: Disable Diagnostics Service Group
tweaks.description: Disables the Diagnostic Policy Service and its service/system hosts (troubleshooters stop working).
tweaks.targetSummary: Service DPS → Disabled; Service WdiServiceHost → Disabled; Service WdiSystemHost → Disabled

tweaks.name: Disable DiagTrack
tweaks.description: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry.

tweaks.name: Disable dmwappushservice
tweaks.description: Device Management WAP Push message routing (telemetry helper).

tweaks.name: Disable PcaSvc
tweaks.description: Program Compatibility Assistant (compatibility pop-ups for old apps).

tweaks.name: Disable SysMain
tweaks.description: SysMain / Superfetch memory prefetching.

tweaks.name: Disable WSearch
tweaks.description: Windows Search indexer.
tweaks.warning: Search becomes slower without an index.

tweaks.name: Disable DoSvc
tweaks.description: Delivery Optimization service.
tweaks.warning: Windows Update and Store downloads may fail or slow down.

tweaks.name: Disable WaaSMedicSvc
tweaks.description: Windows Update Medic Service (repairs Windows Update components). Protected service: written via its service key.
tweaks.warning: Windows will no longer self-heal Windows Update.

tweaks.name: Disable DPS
tweaks.description: Diagnostic Policy Service.

tweaks.name: Disable WdiServiceHost
tweaks.description: Diagnostic Service Host.

tweaks.name: Disable WdiSystemHost
tweaks.description: Diagnostic System Host.

tweaks.name: Disable MapsBroker
tweaks.description: Downloaded Maps Manager.

tweaks.name: Disable Fax
tweaks.description: Fax service.

tweaks.name: Disable PrintNotify
tweaks.description: Printer Extensions and Notifications.
tweaks.warning: Printer pop-ups and some printer apps stop working.

tweaks.name: Set TabletInputService to Manual
tweaks.description: Touch Keyboard and Handwriting Panel (set to Manual).
tweaks.warning: Also powers the emoji panel and some IMEs; left on Manual rather than Disabled.

tweaks.name: Disable QWAVE
tweaks.description: Quality Windows Audio Video Experience.

tweaks.name: Disable SharedAccess
tweaks.description: Internet Connection Sharing (ICS).
tweaks.warning: Mobile Hotspot stops working.

tweaks.name: Disable SSDPSRV
tweaks.description: SSDP Discovery (UPnP device discovery).
tweaks.warning: Media devices and some network discovery stop working.

tweaks.name: Disable upnphost
tweaks.description: UPnP Device Host.

tweaks.name: Disable wisvc
tweaks.description: Windows Insider Service.
tweaks.warning: This PC runs an Insider build (26300) — disabling wisvc breaks Insider flighting.

tweaks.name: Configure Power Plan
tweaks.description: Tune the active plan with sliders: sleep, disk and display timeouts and min/max processor state. The expert view lists every processor setting (incl. hidden ones) with live AC/DC values. Desktop checks: no battery, S0 Low Power Idle, hibernation state.

tweaks.name: Check/Toggle PCIe Link Power Saving
tweaks.description: Turns PCIe Active State Power Management off (AC and DC) so the RTX 4070 Ti SUPER and NVMe links never drop into low-power states mid-game.

tweaks.name: Expose Hidden Advanced Power Settings
tweaks.description: Unhides the Intel hybrid scheduler policies, core parking, boost mode and EPP in Control Panel › Power Options (Attributes = 2).

tweaks.name: Apply Recommended CPU Tweaks
tweaks.description: Applies the Recommended CPU scheduling tweaks.
tweaks.targetSummary: Applies the recommended Performance › CPU Scheduling tweaks

tweaks.name: Prioritize Foreground App CPU Time
tweaks.description: Sets Win32PrioritySeparation to 0x26 (short, variable quanta with foreground boost) so the game in focus gets more CPU time.

tweaks.name: Set System Responsiveness to Zero
tweaks.description: MMCSS reserves no CPU for background tasks (SystemResponsiveness = 0).

tweaks.name: Unpark All CPU Cores
tweaks.description: Sets minimum unparked cores to 100% on AC so all 20 cores stay available.

tweaks.name: Disable CPU Power Throttling
tweaks.description: Turns off Windows power throttling for all processes.
tweaks.warning: This also disables EcoQoS, which RigTune's Game Mode uses to push background apps onto the E-cores. Leave off unless you do not use Game Mode.

tweaks.name: Keep Kernel in RAM / Disable Paging
tweaks.description: Keeps kernel-mode drivers and system code in physical RAM (DisablePagingExecutive = 1). With 64 GB there is headroom.
tweaks.warning: Can make kernel crash dumps less useful.

tweaks.name: Configure Intel Hybrid Thread Scheduling Policy
tweaks.description: Chooses how Windows 11 places threads on the i7-14700F's 8 P-cores and 12 E-cores (SCHEDPOLICY for long-running and SHORTSCHEDPOLICY for short-running threads under SUB_PROCESSOR). HETEROPOLICY is shown read-only in the expert view. Background work keeps landing on E-cores via EcoQoS.

options.name: Prefer P-cores for foreground & short threads
options.description: Recommended for gaming on Raptor Lake.

tweaks.name: Inspect Intel 14th-Gen Microcode & Core Topology
tweaks.description: Read-only: shows the active Intel microcode revision (0x12B or newer recommended) and the P-core / E-core logical processor layout.

tweaks.name: Apply Recommended Graphics Tweaks
tweaks.description: Applies the Recommended graphics tweaks.
tweaks.targetSummary: Applies the recommended Performance › Graphics Pipeline tweaks

tweaks.name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations
tweaks.description: Forces true exclusive fullscreen behaviour for DirectX games globally.

tweaks.name: Check Resizable BAR Support
tweaks.description: Read-only: shows the NVIDIA driver's global ReBAR flag. Resizable BAR also needs Above 4G Decoding + Re-Size BAR enabled and CSM disabled in the motherboard BIOS.

tweaks.name: Disable DWM Transparency
tweaks.description: Turns off acrylic/transparency effects in the shell.

tweaks.name: Disable Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO)
tweaks.description: Disables MPO, a common fix for flicker and stutter with NVIDIA GPUs on multi-monitor / mixed refresh setups.

tweaks.name: Enable Hardware GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
tweaks.description: Lets the RTX 4070 Ti SUPER manage its own VRAM scheduling (required for DLSS Frame Generation).

tweaks.name: Disable DirectX Maximized Windowed Mode
tweaks.description: Turns off "Optimizations for windowed games" (flip-model upgrade of borderless games).

tweaks.name: Disable GPU Timer Interrupt Overhead
tweaks.description: Lowers the graphics kernel's monitor latency tolerance so the GPU is not woken by coarse timer coalescing.

tweaks.name: Disable HDCP Overhead
tweaks.description: Sets RMHdcpKeyglobZero on the NVIDIA display adapter to skip HDCP key handling.
tweaks.warning: Protected content (Netflix 4K, Blu-ray players) will refuse to play until reverted.

tweaks.name: Disable NVIDIA Telemetry Container
tweaks.description: Disables NvTelemetryContainer (skipped if the current driver no longer ships it).

tweaks.name: Disable NVIDIA Network Service
tweaks.description: Disables NvNetworkService (skipped if not present).

tweaks.name: Configure NVIDIA Global Shader Cache Size
tweaks.description: Sets the driver's global shader cache size via nvapi64.dll DRS (0x00A06946). A larger cache reduces shader-compile stutter on your 2 TB NVMe.

tweaks.name: Configure NVIDIA Power Management Mode
tweaks.description: Sets the global Power Management Mode via nvapi64.dll DRS (0x1057EB71).

options.name: Prefer Maximum Performance
options.description: Keeps clocks up; higher idle power.

tweaks.name: Inspect & Toggle NVIDIA Resizable BAR DRS Profile
tweaks.description: Experimental: forces the driver's global ReBAR feature flags (0x000F00BA, 0x000F00BB) for every game instead of NVIDIA's per-game allow list.
tweaks.targetSummary: NVAPI DRS global 0x000F00BA; NVAPI DRS global 0x000F00BB
tweaks.warning: Some games run slower with ReBAR forced on. Requires ReBAR enabled in the BIOS.

tweaks.name: Apply Recommended Input Tweaks
tweaks.description: Applies the Recommended input tweaks.
tweaks.targetSummary: Applies the recommended Performance › Input & Device Pipeline tweaks

tweaks.name: Review/Configure MSI Mode for PCI Devices
tweaks.description: Lists PCI devices with their MSI (message-signaled interrupt) state and lets you enable MSI mode and device priority for the ones you select.
tweaks.warning: A device whose driver does not support MSI may fail to start. Revert restores the exact previous values.

tweaks.name: Choose CPU Cores for GPU Interrupts
tweaks.description: Experimental: pins the RTX 4070 Ti SUPER's interrupts to chosen logical processors. P-cores are 0–15, E-cores 16–27 on the i7-14700F.
tweaks.warning: Pinning to E-cores or too few cores can increase latency.

tweaks.name: Choose CPU Cores for USB/Network/Audio Interrupts
tweaks.description: Experimental: pins USB controller, network adapter and audio controller interrupts to chosen cores (P-cores 0–15, E-cores 16–27).
tweaks.warning: Wrong choices can cause audio crackle or input lag; revert restores Windows defaults.

tweaks.name: Check/Toggle USB Selective Suspend
tweaks.description: Stops Windows suspending idle USB devices (mouse, keyboard, headset, DAC).

tweaks.name: Check Audio Latency Settings
tweaks.description: Read-only Core Audio / WASAPI inspection: endpoints, shared-mode format and engine periods.

tweaks.name: Disable xHCI USB Interrupt Moderation
tweaks.description: Shows your xHCI USB controllers and their MSI state. Interrupter moderation itself lives in controller MMIO registers and needs a kernel driver to change, so RigTune reports it instead of writing it.

tweaks.name: Optimize Raw Input Message Queue
tweaks.description: Reduces mouse/keyboard class driver queue sizes from 100 to 32 events (applies after the next restart).
tweaks.warning: Very small queues can drop input on high-polling-rate mice; 32 is a conservative value.

tweaks.name: Restore All Optional Devices
tweaks.description: Re-enables every device RigTune disabled, restoring their exact previous state.

tweaks.name: Disable Unused Devices
tweaks.description: Lists rarely-needed system devices rated Safe / Moderate / Risky; disable only the ones you select.

devices.note: Breaks redirecting local devices into Remote Desktop sessions.
Only used by legacy MIDI playback.
Used by some virtual devices (e.g. Xbox wireless adapters).
Benefit is disputed; can change timer behaviour.
Intel ME; some firmware and power features depend on it.

tweaks.name: Disable Mouse Pointer Acceleration
tweaks.description: Turns off "Enhance pointer precision" for 1:1 mouse movement.
tweaks.targetSummary: HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\MouseSpeed; HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\MouseThreshold1; HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\MouseThreshold2

tweaks.name: Optimize Raw Mouse Throttle
tweaks.description: Sets RawMouseThrottleDuration to 1 ms (1000 Hz raw-input listener rate) instead of the Windows 11 default of 8 ms.

tweaks.name: Optimize Keyboard Repeat Rate & Delay
tweaks.description: Shortest repeat delay and fastest repeat rate.

tweaks.name: Disable Sticky Keys, Filter Keys & Toggle Keys Popups
tweaks.description: Clears the hotkey-active bit (0x4) in the StickyKeys, Keyboard Response (Filter Keys) and ToggleKeys flags, so pressing Shift 5× or holding Shift no longer interrupts a game. The features themselves stay available in Settings.
tweaks.targetSummary: HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys\Flags; HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response\Flags; HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\ToggleKeys\Flags

tweaks.name: Run SSD TRIM
tweaks.description: Sends a ReTrim to both WD_BLACK NVMe volumes so the SSD controllers know which blocks are free.
tweaks.targetSummary: ReTrim on every fixed NTFS volume

tweaks.name: Apply NTFS Performance Tweaks
tweaks.description: Disables 8.3 short-name creation and last-access timestamp updates on NTFS volumes.
tweaks.warning: Very old 16-bit era installers may rely on 8.3 names.

tweaks.name: Set NTFS Memory Usage to Maximum
tweaks.description: Lets NTFS use more paged-pool memory for its caches (NtfsMemoryUsage = 2); sensible with 64 GB RAM.

tweaks.name: Apply Recommended Network Tweaks
tweaks.description: Applies the Recommended network tweaks.
tweaks.targetSummary: Applies the recommended Performance › Network Tuning tweaks

tweaks.name: Inspect & Test Network Interrupt Moderation
tweaks.description: Shows Interrupt Moderation per physical adapter and lets you switch it per adapter (lower latency vs. CPU load). The adapter is briefly restarted.

tweaks.name: Configure Receive Side Scaling (RSS) per Adapter
tweaks.description: Shows RSS per physical adapter and lets you enable/disable it so receive processing spreads across cores.

tweaks.name: Enable Network QoS / DSCP Traffic Tagging
tweaks.description: Lets local QoS policies set DSCP tags on a non-domain PC ("Do not use NLA").

tweaks.name: Disable Network Throttling Index
tweaks.description: Removes MMCSS network throttling during multimedia playback (NetworkThrottlingIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF).

tweaks.name: Disable Nagle Algorithm
tweaks.description: Sets TcpAckFrequency = 1 and TCPNoDelay = 1 on every physical adapter's TCP/IP interface.

tweaks.name: Apply TCP Optimizer Safe Profile
tweaks.description: Conservative global TCP settings: receive-window auto-tuning Normal, window scaling heuristics off, RSS on.

tweaks.name: Prefer IPv4 Over IPv6
tweaks.description: Keeps IPv6 enabled but prefers IPv4 in the prefix policy (DisabledComponents = 0x20).

tweaks.name: Disable Teredo IPv6 Tunneling
tweaks.description: Disables the Teredo tunnelling adapter via policy.
tweaks.warning: Xbox party chat and some peer-to-peer game networking use Teredo.

tweaks.name: Disable IPv6 Protocol Stack
tweaks.description: Disables all IPv6 components except loopback (DisabledComponents = 0xFF).
tweaks.warning: Microsoft does not support disabling IPv6; HomeGroup-style features, some VPNs and Xbox networking can break.

tweaks.name: Set High-Precision Timer Resolution
tweaks.description: Requests a 0.5 ms timer for RigTune's own process only and measures Sleep(1) before and after. Released on Reset or exit.

tweaks.name: Ignore Brief Network Link Drops
tweaks.description: Keeps the IP configuration when the cable/link drops for a moment (DisableDHCPMediaSense = 1).

tweaks.name: Apply Recommended Registry Tweaks
tweaks.description: Applies the Recommended registry & policy tweaks.
tweaks.targetSummary: Applies the recommended Performance › Registry & Policy tweaks

tweaks.name: Optimize Windows Task Scheduler Maintenance Tasks
tweaks.description: Disables telemetry and data-collection maintenance tasks (compatibility appraiser, CEIP, disk diagnostics, feedback, error queue, maps updates).
tweaks.targetSummary: Task \Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser; Task \Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater; Task \Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator; Task \Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip; Task \Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector; Task \Micro…

tweaks.name: Optimize MMCSS Multimedia Scheduler
tweaks.description: Raises the MMCSS "Games" task: GPU Priority 8, Priority 6, Scheduling Category High, SFIO Priority High.
tweaks.targetSummary: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games\GPU Priority; HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games\Priority; HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games\Scheduling Category; HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games\SFIO…

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Update Auto-Download (wuauserv)
tweaks.description: Windows Update notifies before downloading (AUOptions = 2) instead of downloading automatically.
tweaks.warning: Security updates wait until you install them manually.

tweaks.name: Block Windows Update from Installing Drivers
tweaks.description: Stops Windows Update replacing your NVIDIA and chipset drivers with older WHQL versions.

tweaks.name: Disable Lock Screen Policy
tweaks.description: Goes straight to the sign-in screen.

tweaks.name: Disable Auto-Reboot While Logged In
tweaks.description: Windows Update will not restart the PC while you are signed in (e.g. during an overnight download or game).

tweaks.name: Remove File Explorer Multi-Select Limit
tweaks.description: Raises the 15-item limit for context-menu actions (Open/Print) on multiple selected files to 100.

tweaks.name: Set Menu Animation Delay to Zero
tweaks.description: Menus open instantly (MenuShowDelay = 0).

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Consumer Features
tweaks.description: Stops Windows auto-installing promoted apps and games (Candy Crush, etc.).

tweaks.name: Disable Fast Startup (Hybrid Boot)
tweaks.description: Shutdown becomes a full shutdown, so driver and Windows Update state is always clean (hibernation is already off on this PC).

tweaks.name: Toggle Spectre / Meltdown CPU Mitigations
tweaks.description: Disables the Spectre v2 / Meltdown kernel mitigations (FeatureSettingsOverride = 3).
tweaks.warning: Removes protection against speculative-execution attacks from malicious code. Gains on a 14700F are small.

tweaks.name: Disable VBS and HVCI Security Layer
tweaks.description: Turns off Virtualization-Based Security and Memory Integrity (HVCI).
tweaks.warning: Removes kernel exploit protection; some anti-cheat titles require Memory Integrity ON.

tweaks.name: Disable Hyper-V Hypervisor
tweaks.description: Sets the boot hypervisor launch type to Off.
tweaks.warning: Breaks WSL2 (installed on this PC), Docker, Windows Sandbox and VBS.

tweaks.name: Toggle Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE)
tweaks.description: Disables WinRE (reagentc /disable). Revert re-enables it.
tweaks.warning: Without WinRE, automatic repair and "Reset this PC" from boot are unavailable.

tweaks.name: Switch Classic F8 vs. Modern Boot Menu
tweaks.description: Switches to the classic text boot menu (F8 for Safe Mode). Revert restores the modern menu.

tweaks.name: Toggle Boot Logging (ntbtlog.txt)
tweaks.description: Writes the driver load log to C:\Windows\ntbtlog.txt on every boot.

tweaks.name: Apply Recommended Windows UI Tweaks
tweaks.description: Applies the Recommended Windows UI tweaks.
tweaks.targetSummary: Applies the recommended System › Windows UI Tweaks tweaks

tweaks.name: Disable Hibernation File
tweaks.description: Status-aware: hibernation is already off on this PC, so this normally shows as applied. Turning it off frees hiberfil.sys.
tweaks.warning: Also disables Fast Startup and hibernate.

tweaks.name: Optimize Visual Effects for Performance
tweaks.description: Selects "Adjust for best performance" (animations, shadows and smoothing off).

tweaks.name: Add End Task to Taskbar Right-Click Menu
tweaks.description: Adds End task to taskbar app menus.

tweaks.name: Restore Classic Windows 11 Right-Click Context Menu
tweaks.description: Shows the full classic context menu without "Show more options" (takes effect after Explorer restarts).

tweaks.name: Set File Explorer to Open This PC
tweaks.description: File Explorer opens to This PC instead of Home.

tweaks.name: Disable All Windows Notifications
tweaks.description: Turns off toast notifications for every app.
tweaks.warning: You will also miss RigTune's own tray alerts (e.g. refresh-rate watchdog).

tweaks.name: Disable Bluetooth Background Services
tweaks.description: Disables the Bluetooth support and audio gateway services (bthserv, BTAGService).
tweaks.targetSummary: Service bthserv → Disabled; Service BTAGService → Disabled
tweaks.warning: All Bluetooth devices stop working.

tweaks.name: Stop Windows from Auto-Installing Drivers
tweaks.description: Stops device metadata and driver downloads when new hardware is connected.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Search File Indexing (WSearch)
tweaks.description: Disables the Windows Search indexing service.
tweaks.warning: Start-menu and Explorer search become slower.

tweaks.name: Show File Extensions in Explorer
tweaks.description: Always shows file extensions (safer against fake .pdf.exe files).

tweaks.name: Show Hidden Files and Folders
tweaks.description: Shows hidden files and folders in Explorer.

tweaks.name: Enable NumLock on Startup
tweaks.description: NumLock is on at the sign-in screen and after sign-in.

tweaks.name: Disable Snap Layouts on Hover
tweaks.description: Hovering the maximize button no longer pops up Snap layouts.

tweaks.name: Disable Taskbar Chat
tweaks.description: Removes the Chat/Teams button from the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Tips & Suggestions
tweaks.description: Stops tips, tricks and "finish setting up" nags.

tweaks.name: Enable Full Wallpaper Quality
tweaks.description: Stops Windows recompressing JPEG wallpapers (JPEGImportQuality = 100).

tweaks.name: Remove Clipboard Suggested Actions
tweaks.description: Stops suggested actions (call, add to calendar) popping up when you copy text.

tweaks.name: Disable Start Menu Recommendations
tweaks.description: Hides recommended files and app promotions in Start.

tweaks.name: Disable Safe Search in Windows Search
tweaks.description: Sets Windows Search SafeSearch to Off.

tweaks.name: Clean Up Temporary System Files
tweaks.description: Windows Update leftovers, delivery optimization cache and old logs. Runs from System Care with a size preview.

tweaks.name: Delete Windows & User Temp Files
tweaks.description: %TEMP% and C:\Windows\Temp files not in use. Runs from System Care with a size preview.

tweaks.name: Clear Windows Prefetch Cache
tweaks.description: C:\Windows\Prefetch (rebuilt automatically). Runs from System Care with a size preview.

tweaks.name: Flush DNS Cache
tweaks.description: Clears the DNS resolver cache. Runs from System Care with a size preview.

tweaks.name: Clear GPU Shader Cache
tweaks.description: NVIDIA DXCache/GLCache and the DirectX shader cache (rebuilt by games). Runs from System Care with a size preview.

tweaks.name: Delete Thumbnail Cache
tweaks.description: Explorer thumbnail databases (rebuilt on demand). Runs from System Care with a size preview.

tweaks.name: Clean RAM Working Sets & Standby Cache
tweaks.description: Trims working sets and purges the standby list. Runs from System Care with a size preview.
